description: Vaasan seudun joukkoliikenteen linja-autojen aikataulu- ja pysäkkitiedot is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vaasa. The portal shows the English title as "Schedule and stop information for public transport buses in the Vaasa region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vaasa. Its keywords include Vaasa, liikenne, pysäkki, Joukkoliikenne, aikataulu. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
